entry.title: New: dsh-remote-ssh-ops
entry.summary: SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes). Exact install spec: github:weisiren000/dsh-remote-ssh-ops. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
